dataset_name: Cardiovascular Deconditioning and Orthostatic Intolerance Dataset (Template)
original_source: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA) / PhysioNet Spaceflight Analogues
organism_or_population: Human (Astronaut Flight Crew / -6 deg Head-Down Tilt Bed Rest)
mission_or_experiment: ISS Expedition Continuous ECG & HDT Bed-Rest Analogue Study
known_limitations: Small sample size inherent to spaceflight cohorts (N=15-30 individuals).
High inter-individual baseline variability requires personalized subject-stratified cross-validation.
Bed-rest analogue data may not capture multi-stressor deep space radiation effects.
